# onpager_user_bot_contact (Resource)

Manage one user's bot contact with the tenant permission `user_bot_contacts.manage`. Declaring the contact adopts the existing method for that user and bot, including a method created by a notification template. Destroy deletes the method and clears its references in retained policy steps. Verification records an administrator's assertion without looking up the recipient or sending a message.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "user_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "OnPager UUID of the on-call user."
}

variable "pachca_bot_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "OnPager UUID of the Pachca bot available to the user."
}

variable "pachca_recipient_id" {
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Personal recipient ID known to this bot, for example the string 201 on a load-test mock."
}

resource "onpager_user_bot_contact" "oncall" {
  user_id      = var.user_id
  bot_id       = var.pachca_bot_id
  display_name = "Personal Pachca"
  recipient_id = var.pachca_recipient_id
  verified     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_id` (String) Bot UUID. The user must have access to the chosen bot when creating a binding or switching bots. An update preserves the method UUID. Switching bots clears the previous recipient and verification before applying any explicitly configured replacements. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.
- `display_name` (String) Mutable contact label of 1–200 UTF-8 bytes, without NUL or surrounding whitespace.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user UUID. Changing the owner replaces the contact. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.

### Optional

- `recipient_id` (String, Sensitive) Exact messenger recipient ID, 1–1024 UTF-8 bytes without whitespace or control characters. Omit or set null to use the current recipient on the same bot. A new draft has no recipient by default. Removing this argument preserves the saved address. The API returns the address on read and import, and Terraform stores it in state.
- `verified` (Boolean) Set true to confirm the supplied or already saved recipient. Set false to revoke confirmation. Omission or null preserves verification on the same bot and recipient. A new contact or changed binding defaults to unverified. The current verification status is read into state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable delivery method UUID. Import with the composite ID `user_uuid/method_uuid`.

## Preparing a personal recipient

Use one resource for a user's contact on a given bot. A local user created
with an enabled notification template can already have a draft contact and
policy steps referencing its method UUID. Apply looks up that user/bot pair
as part of the administrative POST. It updates the existing method in place or
creates a method if the pair is new. Declaring the resource takes ownership of
the whole returned contact, including a contact originally created by its user.
Destroy removes it in either case.

Use the recipient ID in the bot's addressing scope. A known recipient and
`verified = true` confirm the address without a sign-in, code or messenger
request. A policy whose remaining requirement was verification can then use
the contact. When creating the user in the same configuration, reference
`onpager_user.<name>.id` in `user_id`; when the user's access comes from a
separate grant, order the contact after that grant.

## Import

Use `user_uuid/method_uuid`. The method UUID is the resource's `id`. A direct
read returns the current recipient and verification state. Terraform marks
`recipient_id` sensitive. Protect state and saved plans containing it.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_user_bot_contact.oncall
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_user_bot_contact.oncall 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555
```

## Lifecycle

Changing the user replaces the contact. Changing the bot updates the same
method UUID. Set the new recipient and verification explicitly to confirm a
contact on a different bot. An omitted recipient preserves the current address
on the same bot. Changing the address clears confirmation unless the request
also sets `verified = true`. Setting `verified = false` revokes confirmation
while retaining the recipient and method.

Destroy deletes the addressed method. Control preserves dependent policy steps
and historical records, clears their references to that method, and releases
the recipient binding. Recreating the contact gives it a new UUID. Import,
refresh and delete use the exact user and method UUIDs. If the user deletes
the contact in their profile, refresh observes its absence. Authorization and
transport failures retain the Terraform resource.

## Permissions

A PAT or service account needs the tenant grant `user_bot_contacts.manage`.
The target user needs access to a bot when creating a contact or switching to
that bot. The administrative read and delete remain available after the user
loses access. Use Control with the administrative contact DELETE route for
the full Terraform lifecycle.
